en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's read a novel
Let's look at a photo collection of islands
Let's read the Bible

Atua told me that He's read that mystery
novel before.

The woman at the start of the story turns
out to be the culprit.

Nyahahaha! Thanks to Atua, I didn't even
need to read it.

This is a collection of photos that were taken
on a previously unexplored island.

Let's see, let's see...
Cannibalism, slavery...
Nyahahaha! How quaint!

I can't believe there are islands like this
with such old-fashioned customs.
...Why would you wanna read that?
I worship Atua—the one true god.

Don't try to get me to be unfaithful to
Atua, Shuichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Angie's inner thoughts...?
